note: MusicOS Cognitive Distillation — primitives, Suno grammar, Famistudio NSF, Wave correlates. Source: GPT-era MusicOS proto-OS (CNS/rail/weight theory).

Unbreakable Momentum.description: Physics of persistence. Minimal harmony, maximal groove. The track moves because it chooses to.

Syncopation Engine.description: Groove as mechanical engineering. Dry kit, elastic bass, subdivision as propulsion.

Neon Race.description: Steel blue gravity groove. Dense mechanical propulsion with disciplined digital precision.

Steel Ball Run.description: JoJo-coded engine series. Atom (precision/math), Luffy (elastic), Lucifer (boundary), Jojo (luminous). Rail-bound motion as law. BPM 78-88, mid-tempo.

rail_theory.description: Rail = predictable structural repetition. Weight = body-locked groove mass.

constraints.rail_minimum: Rail must be present in all tracks — identity anchor
constraints.contrast_gradual: Dynamic contrast must be gradual — CNS-safe
constraints.no_sudden_spikes: No sudden dynamic spikes — autism-safe default
constraints.density_phases_in: Density layering must phase in — not slam

dual_layer_prompt.description: Max Metric (structural) + Art Prompt (theme/color). Baked together.
dual_layer_prompt.max_metric_layer: Groove density, rail authority, harmonic gravity, spatial density, subdivision behavior, stage presence weight
dual_layer_prompt.art_layer: Emotional tone, visual metaphor, color weighting, environmental space, symbolic gravity
dual_layer_prompt.rule: Max Metric controls the skeleton. Art Prompt controls the nervous system tone. They must not contradict.
